audit.whatIsWrong: Our chart (Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs) disagreed with the already-audited mirror on four rows.
audit.why: Mirror (shen__ziggs) set Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill in both layers with ratings moved to match. It is also the truer shape: Ziggs owns levels 1-2 outright, then Shadow Dash at 600 range and Stand United change what 'winning' means.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill — paired full/content rows plus ratings and the four whys that argued the other way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Ziggs spike ('Mega Inferno Bomb threatens him from screens away') with no mention that Shen's 6 is the bigger swing.
audit.why: Stand United is 35000 range on 200/180/160s — a global that converts a lost lane into a won fight anywhere on the map. Mega Inferno Bomb (5000, 120/95/70) is a lane and siege tool; it does not answer a global.
audit.corrected: At 6 Stand United turns his losing lane into a won fight elsewhere — shove and track where he is going, do not celebrate your own ult.
sources: kits: shen R range 35000 cd 200/180/160, global flag; ziggs R 5000 cd 120/95/70

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabrications and one missing interaction. spikes[0] says 'his sword-spirit passive only heals off camps, not your poke' — Ki Barrier is a shield on spell cast and heals nothing. spikes[3] calls Spirit's Refuge a taunt — the taunt is Shadow Dash. And nowhere does the page say what Spirit's Refuge actually stops.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ki Barrier — 'After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield.' Spirit's Refuge — 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked', i.e. basic attacks only, so it eats your Short Fuse autos and does nothing to Bouncing Bomb, Hexplosive Minefield or Mega Inferno Bomb. Shadow Dash is the taunt: 600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s, 150 energy. Stand United is a channel, so any CC on Shen cancels it — Satchel Charge's knock-back is CC.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — your Short Fuse autos stop, every bomb lands through it. Shadow Dash is the taunt at 600 range and 18s at rank 1. Stand United is a channel: knock him with Satchel and the teleport dies.
sources: kits: shen P Ki Barrier text, W block-attacks text, E range 600 cd 18/16/14/12/10 cost 150, R channel flag

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Shadow Dash without a number or its resource cost.
audit.why: 18s at rank 1 over 600 units at 150 energy — Shen is both gapped and out of energy after it, which is the concrete window.

notes: Killed a fabrication that survived on the page: spikes[0] claimed Shen's passive 'only heals off camps'. Ki Barrier is a shield on spell cast and heals nothing. Also killed a mis-slotted ability name — spikes[3] called Spirit's Refuge a taunt; the taunt is Shadow Dash, and Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS only, which is the single most useful fact in this lane: it eats Short Fuse autos and does nothing to any of your bombs. New interaction added: Stand United is a channel, so Satchel Charge's knock-back cancels the teleport. Chart aligned to the mirror across four rows with matching whys. Per the mirror's note, the kit's percentHealth flag on Satchel Charge contradicts Riot's description, so I wrote no armour/MR claim anywhere. spikes[2] still recommends Luden's while report itemization says Blackfire Torch — champion-level inconsistency, untouched.
